Given a video and its corresponding transcript in the source language (e.g., Portuguese) as inputs, the goal of the MCLS system is to generate an abstractive summary in the target language (e.g., English).
Multimodal summarization (MS) for videos aims at integrating multimodal information such as videos and audio transcriptions to generate text summaries.
outputs: abstractive summary in the target language (e.g., English)
